description: Stamps a correlative number (F-0001, F-0002…) on every page of each PDF invoice in a batch and writes numbered copies to a new folder. Numera facturas PDF en lote. Runs locally and offline: the PDFs stay on this computer and the originals are not modified.

background.description: Draw a box behind the number

box_pad_mm.description: Margin between number and box edge

dry_run.description: Report which number each file would get, writing nothing

end.description: Last number. Given alone, the first is worked out from the file count

merge.description: Also write one PDF with every invoice joined

output_dir.description: Absolute folder for the results. Defaults to 'numeradas' beside the first file

password.description: Password of protected PDFs. It passes through the chat: ask only if the tool reports locked files. Numbered copies come out unprotected

paths.description: Absolute paths of PDF files, or folders whose PDFs are all taken (not recursive)

sort_by.description: name: natural order (2 before 10). date: oldest modified first. given: as listed

template.description: Number format with one marker: {n:4} pads to 4 digits (0007), {n} does not pad

x_mm.description: Distance from that edge, in mm

y_mm.description: Distance from that edge, in mm

zip.description: Also write a ZIP of the numbered PDFs

name: number_invoices
title: Numerar facturas
